# Search 1D String Array

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With value = \["dog", "CAT2", "cat99"\], regular_expression = "cat\[0-9\]+", ignore_case = false, start_index = 0, Run displays result = "cat99", index_of_element = 2.

## What this example demonstrates

With value = \["dog", "CAT2", "cat99"\], regular_expression = "cat\[0-9\]+", ignore_case = false, start_index = 0, Run displays result = "cat99", index_of_element = 2.
